flags.message: Pre-snapshot outcomes of other petitions materially inform the forecast: the provisioned petition p. 6 n.1 acknowledges Schneider and Dominguez-Garcia denials, and the opposition pp. 3 and 6 describes January 12, 2026 Johnson and Schneider denials on the related military-review issue. These are legitimate forward context, not Myslow's own outcome, and lower the grant forecast. No Myslow Supreme Court disposition was known, sought, or encountered.
